title: SvgFeSpotLight
responsibility: Renders the native feSpotLight element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFeSpotLight.attributes
inputs.description: Native feSpotLight attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgFeSpotLight.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native feSpotLight element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgFeSpotLight
outputs.description: The actual native feSpotLight element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
